mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that increase the risk of metoprolol accumulation and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and cardiac rhythm closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible or adjust metoprolol dosing based on renal function.
